terms.grammar: phrase: per with interrēte, and emere
terms.comment: Our description, with Traupman’s interrēte for the internet (p. 261). No reference work has a term for online shopping.
On the pattern of situs interrētiālis (website, Traupman 262).

phrases.latin: Calceōs novōs per interrēte ēmī; crās afferentur.
phrases.english: I bought new shoes online; they’ll be delivered tomorrow.

sources: Lewis & Short: emo · Lewis & Short: emptio
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 261–262.
The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
